headline: Chile Q3 GDP Shrinks 1.8% in Sharpest Decline Since 2020
summary: Chile's gross domestic product fell 1.8% in the third quarter, registering its biggest drop since 2020. Central bank president Rosanna Costa stated investment recovery remains slow.
why: Chile is the world's leading exporter of copper and a key economy in Latin America's Andean region.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: A 1.8% drop in quarterly GDP signals economic contraction and sluggish domestic investment.
